_comment: Call sheet for the review-reported dog-friendly properties. Ask exactly four things — pet fee TOTAL (per night or per stay), weight limit, how many dogs, and whether the dog can be left in the room unattended — then one bonus question that doubles as demand research: 'What do guests ask you most often before they book with a dog?' Log the date and the name of whoever told you. NOTHING IN evidenceNote IS A POLICY. It is what guests wrote, it renders on a public page, and it must read as a guest report rather than as research notes — star ratings, competitor observations and instructions to myself do not belong in a field that ships.
_askedOnEveryCall: What is the pet fee, in total — is that per night or per stay?
Can the dog be left in the room unattended?
What do guests ask you most often before they book with a dog?

name: Hotel Bethany Beach

name: Seaside Inn

evidenceNote: The single most useful thing found in this sweep: guests say to ask for the room with a sliding door opening straight onto the lawn.
